approach: Original PS4 x86-64 game code running directly on Windows through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4
notes: Version 0.1.0. Supports USA CUSA19610 1.00/1.01/1.02 (primary, most tested), Europe CUSA19620 1.00/1.01, Japan CUSA10602 1.00/1.03/1.04 and Asia CUSA18093 1.00; the non-USA builds install, boot and pass focused compatibility checks but have not been played start to finish. TRG launcher with package installer. No game files are included.
